storagedrawers_count_sync_holders.note: PlayerList.broadcast (m_11241_) and ChunkMap.getPlayers (m_183262_) are deliberately not fingerprinted: PlayerListCountSyncMixin targets a vanilla class, so a vanilla entry would make Guards log a 'does not match' warning in every pack without Storage Drawers (mixed guard, mod absent). The wrap uses require = 0 and only acts inside Storage Drawers' count send. Since 1.0.36 PlayerListCountSyncMixin has priority 1500 and is listed in Guards.FOREIGN_OVERWRITE: next to another mod's @Overwrite of broadcast (priority below 1500) Mixin no longer refuses the wrap, and postApply turns the filter off (Guards.countSyncBroadcastForeign) with one log line.
storagedrawers_count_sync_holders.conversion: MixinExtras @WrapOperation on Storage Drawers' two sendToPlayersNear calls (scope) and on the per-player send in PlayerList.broadcast (filter; priority 1500, steps aside when another mod replaces broadcast)
